scheme_name: Dayanand Bandodkar Scheme For Higher Education For Orphans
other_conditions: Born in Goa or resided in Goa for at least 15 years
Passed qualifying examination from any institution located in Goa
Must be an orphan (both parents deceased)
Must be enrolled for the first year of degree/PG courses
benefits_summary: Full waiver of tuition, library, laboratory, development fees and other charges such as lodging, food, and transport.
